name: AHB Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，AHB Holdings Berhad 与 Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd 签订合资协议，通过特殊目的公司（SPV）从事发电机组、发电系统及相关配件的贸易与服务业务，并将子公司 Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd 的 3,700,000 股普通股转让给 SBSB 作为合资出资的一部分。此外，公司财政年度结束日发生变更。
overview_en: In 2026, AHB Holdings Berhad entered into a joint venture agreement with Seri Beskaya Sdn Bhd to engage in the trading of generator sets, power generation systems, accessories, components and related services through a special purpose vehicle (SPV), and will transfer 3,700,000 ordinary shares in its 92.86%-owned subsidiary Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd to SBSB as part of its contribution to the JV. In addition, the Company changed its financial year end.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司签订合资协议，进入发电机组及相关业务，并转让 Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd 股份作为出资。
segments.note_en: The Company entered into a joint venture agreement to venture into the generator business and transferred shares in Grid Engineering Sdn Bhd as part of its contribution.
